title: Cabinet Extends PM-KISAN Scheme for 5 Years (FY27 to FY31) with ₹3,15,614 Crore Outlay
summary: Reaffirms DBT income support of ₹6,000 annually to eligible landholding farmer families.

blocks.content: Reaffirms DBT income support of ₹6,000 annually to eligible landholding farmer families.

items: 5-Year Extension: Total financial outlay of ₹3,15,614 crore (over ₹3.15 lakh crore) through FY31.
Disbursement Track Record: Over ₹4.5 lakh crore disbursed since Feb 2019 inception; 1 out of 4 beneficiaries is a woman farmer.

blocks.summary: PM-KISAN provides ₹6,000 p.a. in 3 equal instalments of ₹2,000 | Ministry of Agriculture.
